title: Fold a pop-up laundry hamper
instruction: Twist-fold the pop-up laundry hamper and secure it with its retaining loop.
setup: An empty, ordinary 33 x 33 x 53 cm spring-steel and polyester-mesh laundry hamper, flattened into its full 33 x 53 cm rectangle but not twisted or coiled. Its attached elastic retaining loop lies loose beside it. The flat hamper lies on a 350 x 380 x 100 mm open wooden rest with a 10 mm base and two 20 mm-wide, 90 mm-high rails, 330 mm centre-to-centre on the table with the 53 cm length between the arms and the 33 cm width running forward. Both hands start open, with 2 x 18 x 24 mm silicone finger-pad covers. No latch or fixture holds a folded shape. The loop is sewn through a 12 mm textile tab.
scoring: 1.0 if the hamper forms a packet no larger than 22 x 22 x 6 cm, its retaining loop surrounds it, and it remains within those dimensions for three seconds after both hands release. 0.5 for the same compact packet while held or unsecured; 0.25 for a packet no larger than 35 x 25 cm. Otherwise 0. A broken frame, detached loop or torn fabric scores 0. Use a ruler and the released video.
fidelity: Native elastic triangle surfaces represent the aggregate spring frame, flexible mesh and retaining band. Four flattened frames share one surface with summed stiffness and mass; inter-layer slip is omitted. A sewn textile tab joins the band. Contact, bending and spring-back drive folding; objects are never attached to the hands or commanded to collapse. Materials are approximate and uncalibrated. Development validation is incomplete.
scores: Development only: reset is intact; a successful fold and Dream run are still required.
context: A pop-up hamper must be twisted into nested loops and restrained before its spring frame opens again.
reset_notes: Use a full-size pop-up mesh hamper with an attached elastic retaining loop, such as the 13 x 13 x 21 inch Smart Design type. Open it, inspect the wire and seams, flatten the sides without twisting the frame, then restore the photographed rectangle and loose loop. Do not start from an already coiled frame.
